title: A variable defined before an iterator has the same value for every row
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR S = [Sales Amount] RETURN SUMX ( Customer, S ) )

source.quote: The value of CustomerSales is determined at the beginning, outside of the iteration over Customer . Therefore, its value is the total sales amount
source.supports: a variable defined before SUMX is the total, not the value of the customer being iterated

source.quote: Variables are evaluated in the filter context where they are defined, and their evaluation happens at most once.
source.supports: a variable is evaluated where it is defined, not where it is used

derivation: S = 540 (all 7 sales rows). Customer has 4 rows (Ann, Bob, Cho, Dee) and no blank row, because every Sales[CustomerKey] exists in Customer. SUMX adds 540 four times: 2160. With the measure in place of S the result would be 540.
notes: The type is the type of the summed values, a fixed decimal.
